body:
Hi @beHappyBeLindy thanks for contributing to the project with this issue. To customise the way the values are displayed you should use the CurrrentRefinenements connector: [connectCurrentRefinements](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/connectors/connectCurrentRefinements.html)

It is an higher order component that let you completely customize the view of this widget based on your understanding of your search interface.
